paragraphs.source_en: The buzz of excitement filled the air on board the USS *Santa Fe* Monday morning as the chiefs started talking about their new authority. The sailors took notice and, accordingly, there was more spring in their step as we went about the work of the day. It seemed that the direct connection between the chiefs, who were responsible for making the work come out right, and the sailors, who were the performers of the valve lineups, maintenance procedures, and operational tasks, had engaged both the troops and the supervisors alike. There was greater commitment, greater engagement.

units.source_en: The buzz of excitement filled the air on board the USS *Santa Fe* Monday morning as the chiefs started talking about their new authority.
The sailors took notice and, accordingly, there was more spring in their step as we went about the work of the day.

It seemed that the direct connection between the chiefs, who were responsible for making the work come out right, and the sailors, who were the performers of the valve lineups, maintenance procedures, and operational tasks, had engaged both the troops and the supervisors alike.

ja.t: まれていったようだった。

units.source_en: There was greater commitment, greater engagement.

paragraphs.source_en: Military discipline improved as well. In the past, some of the junior enlisted men would mouth off to their chiefs. (We called this showing “attitude,” which is not a good thing.) Since each chief’s authority to discipline them for their remarks was minimal, these puerile enlisted men could afford to complain; the cost was low. Now, with the chiefs’ having more authority, the junior enlisted men were motivated to suppress their immature responses and get to the work of the day. So far, so good.

paragraphs.source_en: Overall, the mood was upbeat. Yet there was so much to do. We were deploying in 169 days; more urgently, prior to deployment there would be a series of inspections of increasing complexity. We were scheduled to get under way in eight days to do the first of these: an inspection conducted by my immediate superior, Commodore Mark Kenny. He and his squadron staff were going to be riding us for four days, observing *Santa Fe* perform a host of submarine operations.

paragraphs.source_en: I wasn’t sure how we could possibly do well. The knowledge gaps were so big and the operational practice so rusty there was no way we could learn and practice everything we needed to do in the next week. Besides, we had a full 24/7 job just finalizing the repairs and maintenance from the past month, loading stores, and preparing the charts and operational plan to get under way on time.
